questions.stem: What is the basic cause for variations in weathering and resultant biodiversity?
choices: The arrangement of people across a given area
The number of species in a defined area
questions.solution: Solar energy and geographic water are the fundamental factors influencing weathering processes and, in turn, the diversity of life in an area. Solar energy drives temperature and climate, while geographic water affects soil formation and habitat availability. The other options, such as the depth of weathering or the number of species, are effects or outcomes rather than causes.

questions.stem: Which of the following best describes biodiversity?
choices: The number and variety of organisms in a specific region
The number of people living in a given area
The depth of weathering in different regions
The arrangement of species in a habitat
questions.solution: Biodiversity refers to the number and variety of organisms in a specific region, which reflects the range of life forms present. The other options describe unrelated concepts such as human population, geological processes, and species distribution, none of which capture the essence of biodiversity.

questions.solution: Biodiversity refers to the variety of all living organisms, including animals, plants, and microorganisms. It is not limited to just animals or plants. The correct answer is all organisms because biodiversity encompasses the entire range of life forms on Earth.

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of an ecosystem diversity?
choices: A wide variety of plant and animal species in a forest
A single species of bird in a specific region
A single type of tree in a forest
A specific type of rock in a mountain range
questions.solution: Ecosystem diversity refers to the variety of habitats and ecological processes within an ecosystem. A wide variety of plant and animal species in a forest is an example of this. The other options represent species diversity or a single species, not ecosystem diversity.

questions.stem: What is the most likely reason for the high biodiversity in tropical forests?
choices: They receive more solar energy and have more water
They have the highest genetic diversity
They have the largest number of species
They are less affected by human activity
questions.solution: Tropical forests receive more solar energy and have more water, which supports a wide range of life forms and promotes biodiversity. The other options, such as genetic diversity or human impact, are related but not the primary cause of high biodiversity. The presence of many species is a result of these environmental factors, not the cause.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a correct reason for the conservation of biodiversity?
choices: To reduce the number of plants
questions.solution: Preventing the extinction of species is a correct reason for conserving biodiversity because it maintains the variety of life and ecological balance. Increasing land development and reducing the number of plants harm biodiversity rather than protect it. Promoting hunting also threatens species survival and is not a conservation goal.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा जैव विविधता के संरक्षण के लिए एक सही कारण है?
choices: प्रजातियों के विलुप्त होने से रोकने के लिए
पौधों की संख्या कम करने के लिए
शिकार को बढ़ावा देने के लिए
hi.solution: प्रजातियों के विलुप्त होने से रोकना जैव विविधता के संरक्षण के लिए एक सही कारण है क्योंकि यह जीवन की विविधता और पारिस्थितिक संतुलन बनाए रखता है। भूमि विकास बढ़ाना और पौधों की संख्या कम करना जैव विविधता के लिए हानिकारक होता है। शिकार को बढ़ावा देना प्रजातियों के जीवन के लिए खतरा बनता है और संरक्षण का लक्ष्य नहीं होता।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate technical terms as found in Hindi-medium textbooks.

mr.solution: प्रजातींच्या नाशाचा रोख जैवविविधतेच्या संरक्षणासाठी एक योग्य कारण आहे कारण ते जीवनाची विविधता आणि पारिस्थितिक संतुलन बनवते. भूमीच्या विकासाचा वाढ आणि वनस्पतींच्या संख्येचा घट जैवविविधतेवर नकारात्मक परिणाम करतात. शिकाराचा प्रोत्साहन देखील प्रजातींच्या जीवनाला धोकादायक असतो आणि संरक्षणाचा उद्देश नसतो.

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of a biodiversity hotspot?
questions.solution: Tropical rain forests are considered biodiversity hotspots because they contain a vast number of species, supporting a high level of biological diversity. Indira Gandhi National Park and Arunachal Pradesh are specific locations, not general examples of hotspots, while Red Panda is a species, not a habitat. Hotspots are regions with significant biodiversity that are also under threat.

questions.stem: Why might an ecosystem with high biodiversity be more resilient to environmental changes?

questions.stem: If a region has a high species diversity, which of the following is most likely to be true?
choices: It has a low genetic diversity
It has a high ecosystem diversity
It has a low ecosystem diversity
It has a high genetic diversity
questions.solution: High species diversity typically correlates with high ecosystem diversity because diverse species contribute to a variety of ecological roles and interactions, enhancing the complexity and resilience of ecosystems. Other options are incorrect because genetic diversity is not necessarily low in a region with high species diversity, and low ecosystem diversity would contradict the presence of many different species.

hi.stem: यदि किसी क्षेत्र में उच्च प्रजाति विविधता है, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा सबसे अधिक संभावना है कि सत्य होगा?
hi.solution: उच्च प्रजाति विविधता आमतौर पर उच्च पारिस्थितिकी विविधता के साथ संबद्ध होती है क्योंकि विविध प्रजातियां पारिस्थितिकी कार्यों और अंतःक्रियाओं के विविधता के योगदान में सहायता करती हैं, जो पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र की जटिलता और प्रतिरोध को बढ़ाती है। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि उच्च प्रजाति विविधता वाले क्षेत्र में आनुवंशिक विविधता आवश्यक रूप से कम नहीं होती है, और निम्न पारिस्थितिकी विविधता प्रजातियों की बहुतायत के विरोध करती है।
hi.critique: Translation accurately reflects the original meaning, technical terms are appropriately used in Hindi, and the correct answer remains option (2) as in the original.
